name: computer-use-mcp-workspace
description: Clean-room macOS computer control over local MCP

scripts.setup: npm run setup:local && npm run build --workspace @jmeguilos/computer-use-mcp && node packages/mcp/dist/index.js setup
scripts.doctor: npm run build --workspace @jmeguilos/computer-use-mcp && node packages/mcp/dist/index.js doctor
scripts.verify: npm run audit && npm run provenance:scan && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run swift:test && npm run swift:build && npm run swift:universal && npm run pack:verify
